original: House prices have risen dramatically this year.
model: There has been a dramatic rise in house prices this year.

original: You must submit the report by June 18th.
model: The final date for submitting the report is June 18th.

original: I wasn't a bit surprised to hear that Karen had changed her job.
model: It came as no surprise to me to hear that Karen had changed her job.

original: Martin may not be very well but she still manages to enjoy life.
model: Martin's poor health does not prevent her from enjoying life.

original: You'll certainly meet lots of people in the new job.
model: You are certain to meet lots of people in the new job.

original: The television is expensive but it doesn't give very good pictures.
model: Though the television is expensive, it doesn't give very good pictures.

original: If we don't have a quiet room, we can't work well.
model: Unless we have a quiet room, we can't work well.

original: It's the most beautiful sportscar he has ever seen.
model: He has never seen a more beautiful sportscar.

original: When Jim was a boy, he often played sports.
model: Jim used to play sports when he was a boy.

original: Remember to give my best wishes to your family.
model: Don't forget to give my best wishes to your family.

original: His cousin has given up playing video games.
model: His cousin used to play video games.

original: They were such small shoes that the customer couldn't wear them.
model: The shoes were so small that the customer couldn't wear them.

original: We couldn't afford the new production line from America.
model: The new production line from America was too expensive for us to afford.

original: Before the manager's assistant left the workshop, he had told us the changes.
model: After the manager's assistant had told us the changes, he left the workshop.

original: Jeremy is going to have the garage repair the car tomorrow.
lead: Jeremy is going to have the car
model: Jeremy is going to have the car repaired tomorrow.

original: We are going to start painting the house tomorrow unless it is raining.
model: Provided that it is not raining, we are going to start painting the house tomorrow.

original: He ran away lest he should be seen by her.
model: He ran away in order not to be seen by her.

original: "You should have waited for us", the team leader said to Peter.
model: The team leader criticized Peter for not waiting for them.

original: Whenever she goes shopping she buys a new dress.
model: She never goes shopping without buying a new dress.

original: I don't suppose you have change for a pound, do you?
model: Do you happen to have change for a pound?

original: I was particularly impressed by her excellent negotiation skills.
model: What particularly impressed me was her excellent negotiation skills.

original: Sally might not bring her camera to the party, so I'll take mine.
model: I'll take my camera in case Sally doesn't bring hers.

original: She missed the train because she insisted on kissing everyone goodbye.
model: If it hadn't been for her insistence on kissing everyone goodbye, she wouldn't have missed the train.

original: The last thing you should do is to phone the police.
model: Under no circumstances should you phone the police.

original: When the goods arrive at the shop, they are inspected carefully.
lead: They inspect the goods carefully on
model: They inspect the goods carefully on arrival at the shop.

original: The children couldn't go swimming because the sea was very rough.
model: The sea was too rough for the children to go swimming.

original: The mechanic serviced my car last week.
model: I had my car serviced last week.

original: I advise you to put your money in the bank.
model: You'd better put your money in the bank.

original: That restaurant is so dirty that no one wants to eat there.
model: It is such a dirty restaurant that no one wants to eat there.

original: Although he had a good salary, he was unhappy in his job.
model: In spite of having a good salary, he was unhappy in his job.

original: I'm sorry I was rude to you yesterday.
model: I apologize for being rude to you yesterday.

original: "I must see the manager!" he cried.
model: He insisted on seeing the manager.

original: I prefer going out for a meal to staying at home.
model: I'd rather go out for a meal than stay at home.

original: It's possible that he didn't get my letter.
model: He might not have got my letter.

original: If we can solve the problem soon, it will be better for all concerned.
model: The sooner we can solve the problem, the better it will be for all concerned.

original: Lan would have gone to the meeting if she had not been so tired.
model: Lan was too tired to go to the meeting.

original: I can't believe this is the best room there is.
model: There must be a better room than this one.

original: It is a waste of time for you to discuss the problem with Minh.
model: There's no point in discussing the problem with Minh.

original: It is more than a year since I saw Lucy.
model: I haven't seen Lucy for more than a year.

original: I'm sorry I didn't come to see you earlier.
model: I wish I had come to see you earlier.

original: She never remembered to pick me up from school.
model: She never always remembered — She was always forgetting to pick me up from school.

original: They are much better at basketball than me.
model: I'm nowhere near as good as them at basketball.

original: 'Can you meet me after work?' he asked me.
model: He asked me if I could meet him after work.

original: He didn't do very well at university and now he regrets it.
model: He wishes he had done better at university.

original: He waited for her and she arrived over an hour late.
model: He had been waiting for over an hour when she arrived.

original: I will be very happy when I go on holiday.
model: I am very much looking forward to going on holiday.

original: My father last went abroad in 1966.
model: My father hasn't been abroad since 1966.

original: 'Did you read the book or not?' the teacher asked me.
model: The teacher asked me whether I had read the book or not.

original: When she is angry, she never lets him finish speaking.
model: When she is angry, he is never allowed to finish speaking.

original: It took him three months to recover from his illness.
model: It took him three months to get over his illness.

original: I can't afford to pay for all the books I need.
model: My income is not high enough to pay for all the books I need.

original: The company party was so successful that most people didn't want to go home.
model: The company party was such a success that most people didn't want to go home.

original: Sometimes tiredness causes machine operators to make mistakes.
model: Sometimes mistakes are made because of the tiredness of the machine operators.

original: She suggested that I arrive on time for the presentation.
model: She advised me not to be late for the presentation.

original: "Would it be possible to see a copy of the latest timetable, please?" said he.
model: He asked if he could see a copy of the latest timetable.

original: "Let's go fishing."
model: Mary suggests going fishing.

original: An couldn't go swimming because it was raining heavily.
model: The rain was too heavy for An to go swimming.
note: Câu gốc trong OCR bị lỗi ngữ pháp ('because of the rain heavily'), khả năng do quét hỏng. Tao viết lại câu cho trôi — đây KHÔNG phải nguyên văn đề, chỉ là suy đoán hợp lý.

original: Lan won't lose weight if she doesn't stop eating so much.
model: Unless Lan stops eating so much, she won't lose weight.

original: It is a six-hour drive from Phu Yen to Ho Chi Minh City.
model: It takes six hours to drive from Phu Yen to Ho Chi Minh City.

original: Her grandparents raised her as her parents died when she was four.
model: She was brought up by her grandparents because her parents died when she was four.

original: If you don't stop misbehaving, I'll have to ask you to leave the room.
model: If you carry on misbehaving, I'll have to ask you to leave the room.

original: We didn't go to bed early because we were chatting.
model: We stayed up late chatting.

original: I was late because of the heavy traffic.
model: I was held up by the heavy traffic.

original: The performance has been cancelled.
model: They've called off the performance.

original: I regret not studying harder.
model: I wish I had studied harder.

original: The weather was too bad for us to go out.
model: The weather wasn't good enough for us to go out.

original: He is so lazy that he never does any work.
model: He is such a lazy person that he never does any work.

original: Jack will never get the job if he doesn't improve his resume.
model: Unless Jack improves his resume, he will never get the job.

original: "I'll help you with your homework."
model: Tom offers to help me with my homework.

original: It's a ten-minute walk to the nearest shop.
model: It takes ten minutes to walk to the nearest shop.

original: The storm was so strong that we couldn't go sailing.
model: The storm was too strong for us to go sailing.

original: If David doesn't stop smoking, he will harm his health.
model: Unless David stops smoking, he will harm his health.

original: It's a pity she didn't accept the job.
model: I wish she had accepted the job.
